observations.trace: PendingVista stores the latest bundle when no matching SceneEnvironment is passed to accept and present_ready_vista triggers a matching terrain/environment bundle. The production observer requires terrain, ground and environment together; if that complete tuple is absent, it requeues through accept. After an accepted matching tuple, pure geometry preparation failure returns before replacing old vista entities.

conditional_findings.classification: New95e conditional zero-selected-ring city-ground policy question; not an observed presentation or checkpoint3821 finding.
conditional_findings.canonical_owner: Tactical city street/yard presentation and the selected vista-ring configuration at the SceneVistaBundle observer boundary.
conditional_findings.first_failed_contract: Tactical city ground is built only inside near-vista detail spawning, which is skipped when the selected vista-ring list is empty, even though playable urban ground support can already have been retained.
conditional_findings.trace: The server vista_bundle copies streets, yards and input vista lods into one SceneVistaBundle and join sends the retained bundle through an ordered server event. In the tactical client observer, visible_lods takes the configured maximum. With maximum_lods=0, or an input bundle with no lods, prepare_all receives an empty slice and returns an empty prepared list; after successful scene matching the observer updates ActiveVistaSurface, despawns existing VistaTerrain entities and retains playable support when the bundle is urban. The only inspected tactical call to city_ground.spawn is inside spawn_near_vista_details, invoked only when visible_lods.first() exists. Tactical CityStreetPresentation/CityYardPresentation entities spawned by that method also carry VistaTerrain, so this source path does not enqueue replacement city-ground presentation in the zero-ring case.
conditional_findings.counterevidence: The checked-in graphics config selects3 rings and the headless setter selects1. The dedicated sky viewer explicitly sets maximum_lods=0, showing a legitimate specialized zero-ring use but not showing an urban gameplay scene. Source validation permits an empty vista list by checking only an upper bound, but that alone does not prove a complete urban input or application configuration is supported. The playable base ground and its material/ground classification can still exist, so absence of separate paving entities must not be described as every street or yard disappearing.
conditional_findings.comparison: The focused-city worker calls PreparedCityGround::from_scene even when the selected ring slice is empty; it starts from playable extent/support and builds street/yard batches, and FocusedGround.install separately calls spawn_focused on that product. This is a source-path comparison, not proof that either path renders the same image or that the focused policy governs tactical settings.
dependencies: Establish whether zero selected rings and empty input vista are supported for urban tactical play and whether separate city paving is required there.

Trace all city-ground creation, reconnect/observer delivery, retention and material consumers before asserting an actual loss, and compare selected-versus-retained LOD and pending-error findings by exact cause.
acceptance_requirements: For each supported ring count, preserve required playable street/yard presentation independently of optional vista scenery, or define and enforce the intentional zero-ring policy.
